6. Testing considerations
- Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_ai_labels.py`.
- Run the CI-equivalent dry-run smoke:
  `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/ai_labels.py sync-labels --contract-file .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --dry-run`
  and verify the JSON shape stays `created|updated|unchanged|errors`.
- No test edits should be needed.
